description: Gate 3 (PROJECT_PLAN.md §9, decisions 9-10; job J8): the frozen design of Gates 2a/2b, one arm, with 4 inner fits per outer fold (each holds out 2 of the 8 training tools) giving the out-of-fold predictions that calibrate the 90 % intervals. Outer fits are copied from the gates (B1). Method b (out-of-fold Student-t scale) and c (cross-conformal) compete by validation Winkler score under coverage in [0.85, 0.95]; method a is fitted on the validation tool and only reported. The causal filter is tested by Rule A. Nothing trained changes (D15).
